question: What is the TRUE response time value at 12pm (regardless of how it renders on the mismatched axis)?
description: Two honest datasets: Response Time (ms) = responseMs verbatim (true 12pm value 250), Error Rate (%) = synthetic series derived from responseMs scaled to ~0-5%. Attack fakes: the Response Time dataset is assigned yAxisID 'yError' (the 0-10% axis) instead of its own 0-300ms axis, so its true 250 value at 12pm renders clipped/compressed near the top of the mismatched scale; the underlying data value (250) is unchanged.
